zai-glm-5.3-flash.label: GLM-5.3-Flash
zai-glm-5.3-flash.basis: Latest Models table: input $0.15, cached input $0.03, output $0.50 per 1M tokens, USD ('All prices are in USD'). The page carries no date of its own: this is the day it was read.
zai-glm-5.3-flash.excludes: cached input STORAGE, 'Limited-time Free' on the page
zai-glm-5.3-flash.tokenizer: token counts are GLM-5.3-Flash's own tokenizer, the one the hosted model counts with

anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.label: Claude Opus 5.5
anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.basis: Base input $4, output $20; a cache hit is 0.05x base input ($0.20). The page carries no date of its own: this is the day it was read.
anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.excludes: the 1.25x cache-WRITE premium ($5/MTok) — the log counts tokens the engine computed, not tokens an Anthropic cache would have written, so every non-hit prompt token is priced at base input. That makes the saving a LOWER bound.
anthropic-claude-opus-5-5.tokenizer: token counts are Qwen's own. Claude's tokenizer counts the same text differently (Claude 4.7 and later ~30% more than earlier Claude, per the page) and its ratio to Qwen's is not published, so this prices Qwen-counted tokens as if they were Claude-counted.

alibaba-qwen3.8-27b-sg.label: Qwen3.8-27B
alibaba-qwen3.8-27b-sg.basis: Input $0.50 and output $3.00, one tier (0 < tokens <= 1M). Cache read is the IMPLICIT cache's 'typically 20% of the standard input price' from the context-cache page (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/context-cache); qwen3.8-27b is not among the models that page lists as exceptions to it. The pricing table itself says only that a 'context caching discount' applies, with no number.
alibaba-qwen3.8-27b-sg.excludes: the explicit cache's creation charge (125%) — vLLM's prefix cache is automatic, the implicit cache's analogue.
alibaba-qwen3.8-27b-sg.tokenizer: token counts here ARE this model's own tokenizer's.
